highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backends and updates the bundled engine to Skia m152.
highlights_body: It also adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback and Silk.NET Vulkan integration, improves Nano Server font support, and fixes native-object lifetime and allocation-failure leaks.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer from m151 to m152, rolls VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0 while preserving SkiaSharp's allocator fallback, and incorporates upstream font-rendering and Ganesh stability fixes, including fresh texture data after failed flushes.
Adds contexts, recorders, recordings, backend textures and image caching for Skia's next-generation GPU architecture, with Vulkan, Metal and Dawn support across native platforms and browser WebGPU.

Adds RequestReadPixels overloads to SKImage and SKSurface, callback-scoped SKImageReadPixelsResult access and copy helpers, rescale options, and GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion for deferred Ganesh work.

Introduces the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with GRSilkNetBackendContext and typed extension initialization, and makes the parameterless GRVkExtensions constructor public while retaining the SharpVk package.
SKRegion iterators now retain their source region, while SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and WithColorType, WithColorSpace and WithAlphaType retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing use-after-free.

bullets.lead: Failed raster image creation no longer leaks
bullets.detail: SKImage.Create(SKImageInfo) now frees its unmanaged pixel buffer when native raster image creation fails.
Speeds span-capable SKData.SaveTo calls, caches wrapper registration checks, removes an intermediate string from null-terminated text encoding, and pre-sizes SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookups.

bullets.lead: Caller-loaded fonts render on Nano Server
bullets.detail: The Nano Server native asset now uses bundled FreeType, allowing typefaces loaded through SKTypeface.FromStream, FromData or FromFile to render despite the platform's lack of DirectWrite and system fonts.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: FreeType-backed rendering for caller-loaded fonts on Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Faster Windows native builds through one-time Visual C++ environment initialization
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.summary: Updates the bundled engine to Skia m152 with upstream font-rendering, Ganesh stability and stale-readback fixes. Adds Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel readback and Silk.NET Vulkan integration; enables caller-loaded fonts on Nano Server; fixes SKRegion, SKPixmap and SKImage lifetime leaks; and speeds several managed hot paths.

harfbuzz_summary: Co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1, following HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1 in the previous release.
